items.title: A Hope Call that waits for the GM re-read the Hope after the ruling into `now` but wrote and printed the stale `held - cost`
items.old_state: fixed in 1.2.43 (AUDIT-1.2.42.md 2.2: `held = now`); shipped in tag v1.2.44, no tag v1.2.43 exists
items.evidence: calls.mjs:249-260 re-reads the Hope after the yes and sets `held = now`. Since E29 C8 the stale write has no road left: a player's Call that arms a roll (Experience and Ultimate both carry `grants`, config.mjs:2342-2343, 2380-2381) is paid on the primary GM from the Hope the GMs hold (calls.mjs:281 `gmPays`; bridge-runs-records.mjs:582-587), and a GM's own purchase subtracts from the `hope` read inside `meansWrite` (calls.mjs:287-290), never from `held`.
items.pinned_by: scenario 40-flow, check 'gm: p1's Experience on Aiko is paid and armed by the GM after its yes - every write of her Hope and armed list the GM's' (40-flow.mjs:431): fails if the asker's browser writes the Hope again. No test found that moves the Hope during the wait itself.
items.refutation_tried: Looked for another writer of `held - cost`: the only use left is the receipt's `left` (calls.mjs:325); the Reroll's card reads hopeHeld() after the GM's write (calls.mjs:372); the refund reads the Hope again (calls.mjs:314-317).
items.note: Residual wording only: when the GM pays, the receipt prints `held - cost` from the reading taken before the arm (calls.mjs:260, 325) though the GM's answer carries the real `left` (bridge-runs-records.mjs:598), which `armCall` drops (call-effects.mjs:286-290). See new_observations.

new_observations.title: A GM that is not the primary buys a Despair Call without waiting for the primary's write
new_observations.what: `routeToPrimary` sends the change with `void` and answers the expected pool at once, so `spendDespairCall` reads the Call as paid and its effect is applied whatever the primary answers. The primary writes `held + delta` floored at 0 with no price check, so two purchases inside one round trip, or a primary whose pool is lower than this browser's copy (a debt just settled), buy for less than the price; an unanswered request leaves the Call applied and the pool untouched (the asker is told the change was not carried out).

new_observations.title: A Bounty claimed under the Despair darkening, or by a Monocub at its Hope limit, pays 0 Hope while its Despair stays owed
new_observations.what: `claimBounty` drops the Bounty, then `addToPurse` takes 0 in the darkening or at the limit; the Monocub is told '0 Hope in your purse' and the posting pool still pays the Despair it owes, which only a lapse gives back. The purse's rule is written as intended (monocub.mjs:810); whether the Despair should stay owed then is not recorded anywhere I found.

new_observations.title: The overflow caption's comment still says the count is a world setting any player can read
new_observations.what: The comment calls the mask 'a courtesy rather than a secret: the counter is a WORLD setting'. Since E05 C12 the count is the GMs' record and a player's client reads 0 (overflow.mjs:258-259; world-secrets.mjs:93-96), so the mask is real and the comment contradicts the code.

new_observations.title: The Motive picker's comment prices the Motive at nine Despair
new_observations.what: 'Nine Despair is three quarters of a pool; a motive bought without a stated consequence ...' stands over the Motive's three questions; the Motive costs 6 (config.mjs:2910) and New Rule 9 (config.mjs:2921). The same class as the three comments DESP-09 named, in a fourth place.

new_observations.title: A Hope Call's receipt computes what is left from a reading taken before the GM's payment
new_observations.what: When the primary GM pays (a Call that arms a roll), its answer carries the real `left`, but `armCall` returns only true and the whispered card prints `held - cost` from the asker's reading before the arm. A Hope that moves inside that round trip (a roll's grant) makes the card one off; the sheet is right.

new_observations.title: A tier 2 test's name and comment describe the Meddle as paid before the GM is asked
new_observations.what: 'a target in another room is refused on the GM - said and not refunded' explains that 'this side cannot see that anything was paid, so a refund here would be Hope minted'. Since E72 C1 nothing is paid before the GM's conditions (monocub.mjs:1111-1117), so the reason given no longer matches the code the test drives.
